title: barista gradle.json
description: Gradle registry (user level ~/.barista/gradle.json); missing file means an empty registry

installations.description: Registered gradle installations in declaration order

name.description: Unique logical name (auto-named gradle-<version> by add/discover/install, e.g. gradle-8.10.2)

path.description: Absolute gradle home (the directory containing bin/gradle)

managed.description: True when installed by barista gradle install (under installDir); eligible for barista gradle uninstall

default.description: Name of the default gradle installation (set by barista gradle set-default); overridden by workspace properties.json "gradle.default"

jdk.description: JDK spec used to run gradle (major like "17" or a jdk registry name; resolved against ~/.barista/jdk.json); overridden by workspace properties.json "jdk"

installDir.description: Install root for barista gradle install (set by barista gradle set-install-dir); must be an absolute path (~ allowed); default is the builtin ~/.barista/toolchains/gradle
